scope: Source-only Management Persona Compare eligibility, canonical inactive owner precedence, and immutable receipt admission

repair_plan.observed_defect: Qinghe Management Compare automatically selected persona-2448c7053e33ea48da47,agora-servant-4eef59cbdf80a6b9fea0. The second participant was a private Agora Servant, not an institutional trading peer.
repair_plan.additional_defect: Hengyue's named participant panel listed three archived predecessors whose runtime was retired while stale flattened lifecycle metadata still said paper_running.
implementation: Use the scoped, durable resolver receipt to recognise canonical Management Persona origin for compare and legacy consult eligibility. No new request fields or caller-supplied origin authority.

Exclude private/Servant roles using canonical archetype, mandate, strategy_family, persona_class, owner_scope, visibility_scope and memory_scope, at both record and metadata levels. Names and ID prefixes carry no role authority.
Reject private selected peers while resolving Management Compare; at submit recheck against the matching immutable receipt rather than another tab's latest receipt.

Reject explicit inactive administrative owner statuses before operational lifecycle aliases, across all interaction modes. Active owners remain consultable when only the Paper runtime is safely paused.

Preserve ordinary Agora private interactions for the authenticated owner; private records with missing, different or conflicting user bindings fail closed at eligibility and context resolution. Tenant checks remain mandatory.

regression_evidence.production_path: Tests mount create_agora_router and call the actual context:resolve, participants:eligible and interaction submit routes using the real interaction lifecycle receipt store and participant admission builder.

before_fix.first_regression_batch: 10 failed, 19 deselected: private, archived and suspended participants were eligible; private Management Compare context resolution succeeded; another user's private Servant was eligible.
before_fix.stale_receipt_replay: The strengthened matching-receipt regression returned 202 queued with the unmodified router, despite a Management peer having changed to a private role and another tab publishing a newer Agora receipt. The repaired router returns 422 participant_eligibility_failed and stores no interaction.
before_fix.baseline_method: A separate Python process reads git show 5183cbf91:services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/router.py, execs the source into the imported router module before pytest.main, and runs the same regression. Repository files remain unchanged.

coverage: Same-tenant institutional peer included, including active Persona with paused runtime
Private Agora Servant excluded from compare and consult, with ordinary ID/name and every supported canonical role/privacy marker
Cross-tenant, retired and owner-archived/suspended/inactive/disabled records excluded despite stale paper_running aliases
No peer returns only the focused Persona, with explicit excluded reasons and no excluded participant snapshot
Own private Agora workshop remains usable; another user's private selection is denied
Management Talk and Reflect submit exactly the focused Persona with execution_authority=none and broker_called=false
Private peer context freeze and legacy submission rejected
Matching frozen Management receipt enforced even after another tab saves an ordinary Agora receipt
Forged submit source route fails durable receipt validation
